# Dr. Anne Metz — Legal Psilocybin Facilitation for Women | Denver, Colorado

> Dr. Anne Metz, PhD, LPC, is a licensed professional counselor and state-licensed psilocybin facilitator (Colorado Natural Medicine Facilitator License No. NMIT.0000254) based in Denver, Colorado. She specializes in legal psilocybin facilitation for women navigating perimenopause, menopause, infertility and reproductive grief, identity questions, and major life transitions. Medicine sessions take place at Numia Healing Center in Denver under Colorado's regulated Natural Medicine Program (Proposition 122, passed 2022). Preparation and integration sessions are available to anyone via telehealth.

## Key facts

- Practitioner: Dr. Anne Metz, PhD in Counselor Education & Supervision (James Madison University), Licensed Professional Counselor
- Licensed in Colorado, New Mexico, Oregon, California, and Virginia; Colorado Natural Medicine Facilitator License No. NMIT.0000254
- Director of Fluence Training's natural medicine program in Colorado; member of New Mexico's Medical Psilocybin Patient Safety Subcommittee; host of The Psychedelic Skeptic podcast
- Services: legal psilocybin facilitation for women (Colorado only, in person); standalone psilocybin preparation and integration sessions (telehealth, available anywhere)
- A full course of facilitation includes five sessions: two preparation sessions, one full-day medicine session at Numia Healing Center in Denver, and two integration sessions; pricing starts at $3,500 including healing center access
- Insurance is not accepted for facilitation services
- Psilocybin facilitation requires an in-person visit to Colorado for the medicine session; clients travel from anywhere
- New Mexico facilitation expected to begin January 2027
- Psilocybin facilitation is legal in Colorado under the state-regulated Natural Medicine Program — supervised therapeutic use, not recreational legalization
- Free 15-minute consultations offered; contact hello@annemetz.com or (720) 248-7368
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/annemetz/
- Fluence facilitator directory profile: https://directory.fluencetraining.com/profile/9554b2b9-9431-40f0-a93d-8529b11d0f40
- Bio at Numia Healing Center (Denver healing center where medicine sessions take place): https://www.numiahealing.com/about-us/
- Team bio at Odyssey PBC (psilocybin facilitation service in Oregon and Colorado): https://www.odysseypbc.com/our-team
- Psychedelic Support provider profile: https://psychedelic.support/network/anne-metz-phd-lpc/
- The Psychedelic Skeptic on Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-psychedelic-skeptic/id1710038120
- The Psychedelic Skeptic on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/6qhFpLemDobuzZl2dM6uQf
- Psilocybin is not appropriate for everyone; contraindications include personal or family history of psychosis or schizophrenia spectrum disorders and certain medications such as lithium
